name: Runner Extras - Temporary Virtual Table Isolation
brief: Issue #2524: the runner populates system virtual tables (Field 2000000041, Date 2000000007, Aggregate Permission Set 2000000167) into an in-memory store because the service tier computes their rows on the fly. Three of those populates re-run at FIND time, keyed only on the request's table id -- so they also wrote rows into the private store of a `temporary` record of the same table, which must hold exactly what AL put there.
description: The BC-behaviour half of this -- that a `temporary` record round-trips the values AL wrote -- is asserted upstream in the al-language corpus, where a real service tier adjudicates it. This suite asserts the runner-specific half, which only exists because this is the runner: that the runner's own virtual-table populate does not leak into a temporary instance, AND that it still fires for a non-temporary one. Both halves are needed -- a fix that simply switched the populates off would pass the temporary tests alone, and the non-temporary controls are what catch that.
